description: Prioritaire gebieden verdrogingbestrijding Zuid-Holland (TOP) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.zuid-holland.nl. TOP list of desiccated areas of South Holland. The map shows the 21 priority areas for desiccation (the so-called TOP areas) where desiccation is addressed on the basis of the ILG Governance Agreement 2007-2013. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Priority areas for desiccation control South Holland (TOP areas)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2008-08-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
